name: West Sonoma Coast
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Sonoma County AVA of ⟦area|141,846 acres|57,400 hectares⟧ along the coast that contains the Fort Ross-Seaview AVA. Marine winds and fog shape its climate, and much of it lies in the cool Marine climate zone. When it was established in 2022 it had about 47 commercial vineyards on roughly ⟦area|1,028 acres|416 hectares⟧.
